resource_texts.fact_43: Retrieve the magic sword buried with Brandon in Brandon's Barrow Mound, about a three-mile walk through the forest and marked on the party's map. Father William says the black dragon can't be killed without it, though George says no one knows whether the legend is true or where the sword is.
resource_texts.fact_37: Ingrid is making a sleeping potion from the faun wine Dunk brought. Dunk plans to help her into Warwick's house tonight and give it to Warwick, so Dunk can get inside the shop for the mithril shirt while the smith sleeps. The potion is not yet made, and Dunk heavily diluted the faun wine.

rules.last_session: PROVISIONAL: touched threads and standalone beats with narrative_impact and lasting_consequence both medium or high; story order; no cap
rules.want: ongoing pursuit; adventure before side, then importance and actionability; serves_thread is null (an end, not a means) and significance is not incidental (Goals: parent_goal_id null, significance not incidental)
rules.owe: definite_end; commitment_type is not general_agreement; stake, burden and consequence are not trivial (Obligations filter)
rules.blocked_by: active, persists beyond the scene, not covered by immediate danger, and blocks a thread holding a shown want, debt or opening
rules.could_use: openings only; supported enabling action toward a shown want/debt; direct role; equivalent offers/plans use validated canonical fact references; assets stay in state/history
rules.unknown: question_type open_ended and all four dimensions medium or high (Mysteries filter)
rules.threat: harm_origin is not party and no evaluation is low (Brewing Troubles filter); not covered by an immediate danger
rules.all: never possibly moot facts; no caps; no assets in open matters

last_session_candidates.change: Gill agreed to lower the price on the mule after Dunk offered 20 gold, but only once his sons come back.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The negotiation set a condition on the purchase but closed no deal.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The deal now depends on the return of Gill's sons, which ties it to the dragon hunt, so it may come up again.

last_session_candidates.change: Father William marked the witch's home and the Barrow Mound on the party's map, and the party decided to check a marked location on the way to the Barrow.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The beats add two marked locations to the map and set a plan to visit one, but the map's history stays unknown and no treasure was found.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The marked locations and the planned detour on the way to the Barrow will guide the party's next travel.

last_session_candidates.change: The Clurichen Naggeneen was caught stealing Quinn's drink and now hangs in a bag behind Quinn's bar, his fate in Quinn's hands.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The beats answer who the Clurichen is and show him captured, refused release by Phidipaldi and handed to Quinn.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Naggeneen is still alive in the bag, Quinn has an unstated plan for him, and he offered a pot of gold and a secret, so he is likely to return.

last_session_candidates.change: Trout recruited the halfling Squints into his Halfling Corps on terms that promise him second pick of the first treasure, and Squints rescued Brother Dirk, who now reports to him.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The party gained a new follower, who brought another follower, under terms with a treasure share still owed, though the party privately treats him as expendable.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Squints and Dirk now travel with the party, and the unpaid treasure share and the party's willingness to abandon him will come up again.

last_session_candidates.change: The ale thief turned out to be the Clurichen Naggeneen rather than Bentley, and Quinn paid Phidipaldi, Trout and Uriah 33 gold each.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The beats resolve the thread by catching the thief, clearing Bentley and settling the deal with Quinn.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The job is finished and the payment is ordinary treasure, though Bentley being cleared may matter slightly.

last_session_candidates.change: Dunk found a glowing magical mithril chain shirt in Warwick's shop and began working on a plan to get it.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The beats reveal a desirable magic item and start a scheme to steal it.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Dunk said he has a plan and will go out one more night, so the theft is likely to come up next Session.

last_session_candidates.change: Dunk struck a deal with Ingrid to get her a sleeping potion for Warwick, traded the fauns for a flask of faun wine, and gave her a heavily diluted batch to brew with.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The beats establish a bargain with Ingrid, gain the party a flask of faun wine, and leave Ingrid owing Dunk a favor.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The potion is still being brewed, Dunk plans to meet Ingrid again tonight, and he still holds some of the faun wine, so this carries forward.

last_session_candidates.change: Nothing lasting changed; the party learned what remedies and powders Ingrid sells.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The beat only describes the goods in Ingrid's shop.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Knowing her stock may matter only for later shopping.

last_session_candidates.change: Nothing lasting changed; shipments still had not arrived.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The only beat repeats that shipments hadn't come in.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The beat adds nothing new to the open question.

last_session_candidates.change: The party learned the black dragon reportedly can't be killed without Brandon's sword, will soon be able to fly, and has a poisonous bite, sulfur spit and unpierceable scales, and that Eric may not have the bounty.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Father William's and George's accounts reshape the hunt by revealing that a specific sword is needed, that time is short before the dragon flies, and that the reward may not exist.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The sword requirement, the coming flight and Phidipaldi's vow to bring his lance for George will drive the dragon hunt in later Sessions.

last_session_candidates.change: The party learned that Brandon's magic sword, needed to kill the dragon, lies in the Barrow Mound about three miles away, and set out for it.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The beats set a new main goal for the party, which is to retrieve the sword from the Barrow.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The trip to the Barrow and the sword will shape the next Sessions.

last_session_candidates.change: Nothing lasting changed; Father William had no books for Uriah and offered to heal him if he is injured.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The beat is a minor offer from the priest.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Healing might be available later, but the offer is minor.

last_session_candidates.change: The party learned of Vivian, a witch in the woods who is Ingrid's friend; Father William marked her home on the map, and the party chose to avoid it.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The beats introduce a new figure whose location is now known, along with Ingrid's report that hidden fairies are appearing more often.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Vivian's home is marked on the party's map and she is tied to Ingrid, so she may come up again.

last_session_candidates.change: Uriah promised Father William he would do penance at the Barrow Mound and donate 10 gold for its upkeep.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The beat records a small promise made to the priest.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The penance is still owed at the Barrow, where the party is heading.

last_session_candidates.change: Uriah bought essence of wolfsbane and mandrake root tea from Ingrid.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The beat is a purchase of minor consumables.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The healing tea and wolfsbane may be used later.

last_session_candidates.change: The party discovered a man-eating giant in the woods north of town, rescued his captive Brother Dirk and escaped.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The beats reveal a new foe and show the party rescuing his intended meal.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The angered giant still lives near the route north and could return.
